scope: True one-sided FFT HFC candidate; unchanged original 10 case/channels plus 8 controls; no production MIR admission

dependency.licenses: Apache-2.0 for MIR and FFT; full resolved metadata artifact path and SHA-256 recorded below

coordinate_contract.support: Only real PCM interval [start,end), no zero padding
coordinate_contract.coordinate: start + floor((end-start)/2), equivalent to ceil discrete support center
coordinate_contract.tail: Append [length-128,length) when regular windows do not reach EOF; last hop can be shorter than64
coordinate_contract.short: One actual short window, FFT and Hamming length equal PCM length; single-frame upstream picker failure preserved
coordinate_contract.api_time_s: Recorded unchanged for each analysis index but not interpreted as window-center PCM time

comparison_to_rms64.note: These cases still FAIL because frame0 attack is missed; decreased false positives alone do not prove admission

known_limits: Frame0 onset missed for constant level, stationary noise and sustained tones
Stationary noise still produces one extra peak
Upstream picker can mark equal-height adjacent maxima, no minimum peak distance
EOF window can shorten hop and change threshold context physical duration

source_findings.onset_strength.rs:111-127: HFC receives supplied spectra, raw API timestamp is ordinal*hop/rate
source_findings.onset_strength.rs:147-169: Picker uses local mean and non-strict local max without endpoint exclusion, minimum spacing or single-frame baseline
source_findings.onset_strength.rs:204-208: HFC sums frequency-bin index weights times squared magnitude
source_findings.window.rs:102-125: Native Hamming handles N=0,1 and uses0.54-0.46cos for longer actual windows

fixture_provenance.frequency_check_waveforms: Original bin4/bin20 cosine frames generated in this probe; CC0-1.0

software_checks.tests: PASS: 2, including inherited matcher regression and native spectral/coordinate check

independent_review.scope: Read-only source, all18case coordinates/labels, independently recomputed matching metrics and dependency sets
independent_review.checks_run: No Cargo or GPU; independent Python report verification
